observations: Photo 0: pink melodica (pianica) open, showing full keyboard, air tube, mouthpiece, and pink case interior.
Photo 1: closed pink case with 'YAMAHA' logo embossed on the front, worn and dusty surface.
Photo 2: a case of similar ribbed shape but appears white/gray (different lighting or different unit) resting beside a separate, larger keyboard with different key styling than photo 0.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / AVANT-GARDE MUSIC' present on all photos, suggesting a dealer listing.
No visible model number or serial plate in any photo.

claims.claim: "If you need a keyboard that will fit into your budget, dont worry we've got you covered"
claims.evidence: Marketing language, not a factual claim about the item's condition or function.

risks.risk: Melodica's reed/airway condition and sound quality cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
risks.proof: A short video of someone blowing into the mouthpiece and playing a scale across all keys.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needs servicing

risks.risk: Mouthpiece and air tube hygiene (second-hand, shared use) not assessable.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of mouthpiece tip and tube interior, confirming cleanliness or if a replacement is included.

risks.risk: Photo 2 shows a differently colored case next to an unrelated full-size keyboard, raising doubt whether all photos belong to the same unit being sold.
risks.proof: A single photo showing the actual case and keyboard together in consistent lighting, plus a wide shot of the full item for sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lesser-condition/unverified unit shown in photo 0/1 only, ignoring photo 2 claims

risks.risk: Missing or damaged keys, stuck keys, or warped case not visible from current angles.
risks.proof: Photos from multiple angles showing all keys unobstructed and case latches intact.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only, functional defects assumed possible

proof_requests: Video of melodica being played to confirm reed function and airflow.
Clear, consistent-lighting photo confirming photo 2's case matches the one in photos 0 and 1.
Close-up of mouthpiece and tube for hygiene/condition check.
Photo of all keys from directly above, unobstructed, to confirm none are stuck or missing.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Yamaha melodica from the case branding, so it can be priced at worst case (unproven function, hygiene unverified) despite the mismatched third photo, which is flagged as a risk rather than a blocker.
